name: mcdev-mcp
description: Minecraft development tools backed by the mcdev-mcp server. Requires a released Java 26 JDK; the launcher enables Java 26 preview features.

script_logs.title: Script log directory
script_logs.description: Optional directory containing JSON Lines script logs.

run_command.title: Enable game commands
run_command.description: Allow mc_run_command to send slash commands through DebugBridge.

debug_log.title: Debug log
debug_log.description: Optional mcdev-mcp debug-log path, or on/off.

index_threads.title: Indexer workers
index_threads.description: Optional maximum number of Java source-indexing workers.
